mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT fnd31_fund_id FROM fnd31_opr_fund WHERE fnd31_opr_id = #{oprId} ORDER BY fnd31_fund_id

SELECT fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id AS fund_id , f_cdnm('IcamFundType', fnd02.fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd, fnd01.fnd01_company_id, fnd02.fnd02_work_date) AS fund_type_name , COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_cd, fnd01.fnd01_fund_cd) AS fund_code , COALESCE(fnd02_r.fnd02_fund_nm, fnd02.fnd02_fund_nm) AS fund_name FROM fnd01_fund_code fnd01 INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info fnd02 ON ( fnd02.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id AND fnd02.fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info x WHERE x.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id AND x.fnd02_work_date <= f_today() ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01_r ON fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd02_fund_info fnd02_r ON ( fnd02_r.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id AND fnd02_r.fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info x WHERE x.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id AND x.fnd02_work_date <= f_today() ) ) WHERE fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = #{fundId} AND fnd01.fnd01_company_id = #{companyId}
